title: Tirzepatide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Obesity
journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

key_findings.claim: Tirzepatide achieved up to 20.9% average body weight reduction at 72 weeks in adults with obesity
key_findings.citation_location: Jastreboff et al., N Engl J Med 2022;387:205-216, Coprimary Outcome
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor co-agonism resets hypothalamic hunger set-points with superior fat clearance.

key_findings.claim: 91% of participants achieved at least 5% clinically meaningful weight loss with highest dose
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Steer monitors body composition via regular DEXA scanning to protect lean muscle during deep weight clearance.

key_findings.claim: Indian bodies store higher visceral fat (TOFI phenotype), requiring clinical diagnostics before medicine
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Standard BMI is inadequate for Indians; DEXA scans and 55+ biomarkers are essential for clinical safety.
